Record Class DataPackArchive.Inspection

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.copperbench.core.workspace.DataPackArchive.Inspection
Record Components:
root - the folder inside the ZIP that holds pack.mcmeta: empty, or one wrapping folder
description - the plain-text pack description, or null when it is absent or a text component
suggestedGeneratorId - the newest bundled generator whose pack format the pack declares, or null
suggestedModId - the pack's own namespace when it is also a valid workspace ID, or null
skipped - top-level entries other than data/, pack.mcmeta and pack.png
droppedMetadata - pack.mcmeta fields the generated pack.mcmeta does not keep
Enclosing class:
DataPackArchive
